select * from (
SELECT channel.*,GROUP_CONCAT(ssubscribeNumUserAccess.user_id) as subscribeUserIds,
IF( IFNULL((
SELECT count(1) FROM gc_user_access_permission per LEFT JOIN gc_user_access acc ON acc.id = per.user_access_id WHERE JSON_CONTAINS( per.subscribe_permission, CONVERT ( channel.id, CHAR ))= 1 and acc.user_id = #{userId} and acc.master_id=#{masterId} GROUP BY acc.user_id
), 0 ) =0,0,1) AS followFlag,/*区分自己订阅的还是小队默认绑定的*/
info.last_name AS createUserLastName,/*用户信息*/ info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, /*用户信息*/ tags.id AS tag_id, /*用户标签*/ tags.channel_id AS tag_channel_id, /*用户标签*/ tags.type AS tag_type,/*用户标签*/ tags.tag_text AS tag_text,/*用户标签*/ group_concat( tags.tag_text ) AS channelTags/*用户标签*/
FROM pt_channel channel /*channle表*/ LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe sub on channel.id = sub.channel_id /*订阅频道表*/ left join gc_user us on us.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id /*user用户信息*/ left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = channel.id /*channel标签表*/
LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission permission ON JSON_CONTAINS( permission.subscribe_permission, CONVERT ( channel.id, CHAR ))= 1/*存在就连接*/
LEFT JOIN gc_user_access userAccess on userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id /*权限表*/
LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission accessPermission ON JSON_CONTAINS( accessPermission.channel_permission, CONVERT ( channel.id, CHAR ))= 1
LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access on access.id = accessPermission.user_access_id
LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission subscribeNumPermission ON JSON_CONTAINS( subscribeNumPermission.subscribe_permission, CONVERT ( channel.id, CHAR ))= 1
LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ssubscribeNumUserAccess on ssubscribeNumUserAccess.id = subscribeNumPermission.user_access_id WHERE 1 = 1 and level=0/*type为0查不是自己创建的channel，为1查询自己创建的channel*/ /*查询channel上面的*/ and userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id =#{masterId} and JSON_CONTAINS( permission.subscribe_permission, CONVERT ( channel.id, CHAR ))= 1 or ( channel.create_user_id =#{userId} and channel.level=0 and channel.master_id = #{masterId})
/*查詢channel下面的*/ and access.user_id = #{userId} and access.master_id=#{masterId} and (JSON_CONTAINS( accessPermission.subscribe_permission, CONVERT ( channel.id, CHAR ))= 0 or JSON_CONTAINS(accessPermission.subscribe_permission,CONVERT ( channel.id, CHAR )) is null ) /*如果两个字段都有就代表强制绑定的课程*/ and JSON_CONTAINS(accessPermission.channel_permission, CONVERT(channel.id, CHAR))=1 and ( channel.create_user_id !=#{userId} and channel.level=0 ) and channel.master_id = #{masterId}
GROUP BY channel.id order by channel.create_time desc
) as channels where channels.followFlag=0 order by channels.create_time desc

SELECT channel.*, IFNULL((select count(ua.id) from gc_access access LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua on ua.access_id=access.id where JSON_CONTAINS(access.subscribe_json,concat('',channel.id,'')) ),0) as subscribeNum,info.last_name as createUserLastName, info.first_name as createUserFirstName,tags.id as tag_id,tags.channel_id as tag_channel_id,tags.type as tag_type,tags.tag_text as tag_text, group_concat(tags.tag_text) as channelTags FROM pt_channel channel left join gc_user us on us.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = channel.id left join gc_user_access_permission permission on JSON_CONTAINS(permission.channel_permission, CONVERT(channel.id, CHAR))=1 left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_access access on access.id = ua.access_id where access.id=#{accessId} and ua.master_id=#{masterId} group by channel.id

select ch.*, u.username as channel_create_user_username,u.id as channel_create_uid,info.last_name as createUserLastName, info.first_name as createUserFirstName,tags.id as tag_id,tags.channel_id as tag_channel_id,tags.type as tag_type,tags.tag_text as tag_text, group_concat(tags.tag_text) as channelTags, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id from pt_channel ch left join gc_user u on u.id = ch.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = u.info_id left join sys_file file on file.id = info.avatar_file_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = ch.id
where 1=1 and ch.id in
#{channelId}
where 1=2
and ch.channel_name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
group by ch.id

and concat(chs.channel_name,chs.channel_slug) like concat('%',#{searchName},'%')

select channel.channel_img_file_id,channel.`desc`,channel.create_user_id,channel.visible_flag,channel.category_id, channel.level,channel.fid,channel.`order`,channel.master_id,ifnull(channel.channel_slug,ch2.channel_slug) as channel_slug,channel.create_time, channel.update_time,channel.channel_avatar_file_id, ifnull(ch2.id,channel.id) as id, ifnull(ch2.channel_name,channel.channel_name) as channel_name, file.id as fileId, info.last_name AS createUserLastName, info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id, us2.id as channel_create_uid, count(vac.id) as likeNum, if(vac.user_id=#{userId},1,0) as likedFlag, pcc.id as channelContentId from sys_file file left join pt_channel_content pcc on file.id = pcc.file_id left join pt_channel channel on pcc.channel_id = channel.id left join pt_channel ch2 on ch2.id = channel.fid left join gc_user_access_permission permission ON JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_MERGE(ifnull(permission.subscribe_permission,'[]'),ifnull(permission.channel_permission,'[]')),CONVERT ( ifnull(ch2.id,channel.id), CHAR ))= 1 left join gc_user_access userAccess ON userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_user us on us.id = userAccess.user_id left join gc_user us2 on us2.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us2.info_id left join gc_user_video_action vac on vac.file_id = file.id and vac.`type` = 1 where 1=1 and (userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and us.id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id = #{masterId} OR ( channel.create_user_id =#{userId} AND channel.master_id = #{masterId} ) and pcc.id is not null)
and file.`name` like concat('%',#{searchName},'%')
GROUP BY file.id order by file.update_time desc

select file.file_url channel_video_file_url, file.save_type as channel_video_save_type, file.file_type_index as channel_video_type_index, file.thumb_nail_id as channel_thumb_nail_id, file.thumb_nail_url as channel_thumb_nail_url ,file.id as video_file_id, channel.*, us.username as channel_create_user_username,us.id as channel_create_uid,info.last_name as createUserLastName, info.first_name as createUserFirstName, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id from pt_channel channel left join pt_channel_content pcc on channel.id = pcc.channel_id left join gc_user_access_permission permission ON JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_MERGE(ifnull(permission.channel_permission,'[]'),ifnull(permission.subscribe_permission,'[]')),CONVERT ( channel.id, CHAR ))= 1 left join gc_user_access ac on ac.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_user us on ac.user_id = us.id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join sys_file file on file.id = pcc.file_id where 1=1 and ac.user_id = #{userId} and ac.master_id = #{masterId} and file.id is not null
group by file.id order by file.update_time desc

select f.*,count( vac.id ) AS likeNum , if(vac.user_id=#{userId},1,0) as likedFlag from (select channel.channel_img_file_id,channel.`desc`,channel.create_user_id,channel.visible_flag,channel.category_id, channel.level,channel.fid,channel.`order`,channel.master_id,ifnull(channel.channel_slug,ch2.channel_slug) as channel_slug,channel.create_time, channel.update_time, file.update_time as file_update_time, ifnull(ch2.channel_avatar_file_id,channel.channel_avatar_file_id) as channel_avatar_file_id, ifnull(ch2.id,channel.id) as id, ifnull(ch2.channel_name,channel.channel_name) as channel_name, file.id as fileId, info.last_name AS userInfo_lastName, info.first_name AS userInfo_firstName, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id, us2.id as channel_create_uid, us2.username as channel_create_user_username, pcc.id as channelContentId from sys_file file left join pt_channel_content pcc on file.id = pcc.file_id left join pt_channel channel on pcc.channel_id = channel.id left join pt_channel ch2 on ch2.id = channel.fid left join gc_user_access_permission permission ON JSON_CONTAINS(ifnull(permission.subscribe_permission,'[]'),CONVERT ( ifnull(ch2.id,channel.id), CHAR ))= 1 left join gc_user_access userAccess ON userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_user us on us.id = userAccess.user_id left join gc_user us2 on us2.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us2.info_id where 1=1 and userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and us.id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id = #{masterId} and pcc.id is not null or((channel.create_user_id = #{userId} or ch2.create_user_id = #{userId}) and channel.master_id = #{masterId}) and channel.master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY file.id order by file.update_time desc ) as f left join gc_user_video_action vac on f.fileId = vac.file_id and vac.`type` = 1 GROUP BY f.fileId order by f.file_update_time desc

select b.*,count(play.id) as playNum from ( select channel.channel_img_file_id,channel.`desc`,channel.create_user_id,channel.visible_flag,channel.category_id, channel.level,channel.fid,channel.`order`,channel.master_id,ifnull(channel.channel_slug,ch2.channel_slug) as channel_slug,channel.create_time, channel.update_time, ifnull(ch2.channel_avatar_file_id,channel.channel_avatar_file_id) as channel_avatar_file_id, ifnull(ch2.id,channel.id) as id, ifnull(ch2.channel_name,channel.channel_name) as channel_name, file.id as fileId, file.create_time as file_create_time, file.update_time as file_update_time, info.last_name AS createUserLastName, info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id, count(vac.id) as likeNum, if(vac.user_id=#{userId},1,0) as likedFlag,
info.last_name AS userInfo_lastName, info.first_name AS userInfo_firstName, us2.id as channel_create_uid, us2.username as channel_create_user_username, pcc.id as channelContentId from sys_file file left join pt_channel_content pcc on file.id = pcc.file_id left join pt_channel channel on pcc.channel_id = channel.id left join pt_channel ch2 on ch2.id = channel.fid left join gc_user_access_permission permission ON JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_MERGE(ifnull(permission.subscribe_permission,'[]'),ifnull(permission.channel_permission,'[]')),CONVERT ( ifnull(ch2.id,channel.id), CHAR ))= 1 left join gc_user_access userAccess ON userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_user us on us.id = userAccess.user_id left join gc_user us2 on us2.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us2.info_id left join gc_user_video_action vac on vac.file_id = file.id and vac.`type` = 1 where 1=1 and userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and us.id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id = #{masterId} and pcc.id is not null and channel.id is not null OR ( channel.create_user_id =#{userId} AND channel.LEVEL = 0 AND channel.master_id = #{masterId}) GROUP BY file.id,permission.id order by count(vac.id) desc ,file.update_time desc ) as b left join gc_user_video_play play on play.file_id = b.fileId GROUP BY b.fileId order by likeNum desc ,count(play.id) desc,file_update_time desc
